_doc: Ephemeris chart regression cases. Each case's INPUT is a birth instant (UTC) + coordinates.
The 'expected' Moon placement is the authoritative Drik Panchang result and starts null with
1. Open Drik Panchang Kundli / birth chart for the same birth date, exact time, and place.
Ensure Ayanamsa = Lahiri and the chart is sidereal (Nirayana).
2. Read the Moon's Rashi, Nakshatra and Pada and copy them into 'expected'; set status FILLED.
3. Times here are UTC. Convert the local birth time to UTC exactly as Drik Panchang used it.
BOUNDARY CASES (the spec's core concern): add cases where the Moon sits within ~1 degree of a
Nakshatra/Rashi transition, and record in 'note' that a small time change flips the result.
These are the highest-value cases for catching ayanamsa/precision drift.
Cases with status != FILLED are SKIPPED. The whole file is also skipped when swisseph or the
.se1 data files are unavailable (e.g. CI without ephemeris data).

cases.note: PLACEHOLDER for a Moon-near-Nakshatra-boundary case; replace utc/coords with a real boundary birth and record the flip in this note
